title: smejj.com: AI Coding Agent
short: AI coding agent & chat assistant: write code, search the web, create, automate.
long:
smejj.com is an autonomous AI agent and AI chat assistant in one app. It writes and tests its own code, chats and speaks with you, sees your screen, searches the web, creates images and videos, and operates its own browser — running tasks from start to finish with little to no help from you.

AI CODING AGENT FOR DEVELOPERS
• A real AI coding agent: describe what you want built and let it write, run, test and improve the code
• An autonomous coding assistant — plan a task, and it keeps going until it is done
• AI code generator with syntax highlighting: copy, download or open the code in a larger view
• Debug, refactor and explain code in Python, JavaScript and many other languages
• Connect GitHub, preview results and follow the status of a job
• Organise your work into projects with their own coding workspace
• Write your own rules the assistant has to follow
• Pick a permission mode — you decide when smejj.com asks before it changes anything

AI CHAT ASSISTANT: ASK ANYTHING
• Choose how it answers: Fast, Thorough, or Expert models
• Turn on Thinking for slower, more careful answers
• AI web search with the sources behind every answer
• Have any answer read aloud, or copy it with one tap
• Write, summarise and rewrite text

BRING ANYTHING INTO THE CONVERSATION
• Attach files and images and ask questions about them
• Take a photo or video, or use your camera live
• Share your screen — smejj.com sees it and can act on what is there
• AI voice assistant: speak instead of typing, or switch to full voice mode

CREATE: AI IMAGE AND VIDEO GENERATOR
• Generate images from a text description
• Turn a description into a video, complete with a narrated voice-over
• Turn ideas into working code you can copy, download or open in a larger view

BROWSER AUTOMATION AND SCHEDULED TASKS
• smejj.com can operate the mouse and browser itself — not just click through a site, but work in it, and replay every step it took
• Schedule jobs so they run on their own, start to finish, like a background AI agent

BUILT TO BE QUIET ABOUT YOUR DATA
• No ads, no tracking, no analytics
• Your texts are never used for training
• Your conversations follow you across devices, tied to your account
• Delete a conversation and it is removed from storage too

Whether you are an AI programmer looking for a fast, autonomous coding agent, or you want one AI workspace for chat, code, web search, images, video and voice — smejj.com runs your tasks from start to finish.

Note: images and videos are AI-generated. An account is required.
